references.text: Jesus' prophecy that a disciple would deny him three times before the rooster crows is repeated with almost identical wording in the Gospel of Mark.
Luke reports the same prophecy about three denials before the rooster crow, emphasizing Jesus' knowledge of Peter's future actions.
Matthew documents Jesus' direct statement that Peter would deny him three times before the rooster crow, as a fulfillment of the prophecy.
The fulfillment of the prophecy is described where Peter denied Jesus three times, and the rooster crowed just as Jesus had predicted.
